questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.question: A classroom has 20 rows with 4 chairs in each row. How many chairs are there altogether?
questions.explanation: Total chairs = rows × chairs per row = 20 × 4 = 80.
questions.source: Original practice question; answer checked by calculation
